summary: v52bu end-to-end verification of 3 features (Vendor Signatures 'Admin signed · your turn' sync, EMD per-bid receipt PDF, Vendor sidebar Categories+Services on VendorEmdE/VendorAlertsE). Backend pytest 5/5 PASS: unauth 401, bogus bid 404, paid tx returns 200 application/pdf with Content-Disposition filename 'PMC-EMD-Receipt-...', unpaid bid 404, and inserted docusign_envelopes {status='signed', signer_email=manualvendor} surfaces in GET /api/v1/docusign/mine with status preserved (seed data cleaned up). Frontend verified live as manualvendor: (1) Sidebar on /vendor/emd, /vendor/alerts, /vendor and /vendor/signatures each contain both <a href='/vendor/categories'> (Categories, i-tag) and <a href='/vendor/services'> (Services, i-briefcase) inside nav.pmc-lnav — regression-free. (2) /vendor/categories and /vendor/services routes render non-blank pages (VendorPurchase shows 21 subscription cards). (3) /vendor/emd renders 2 receipt links with data-testid='vemd-receipt-PMC-BID-2026-00017' and data-vemd-receipt-bid='6ab5c687aea85dfaba78a25e'; clicking the first receipt link triggered a request to /api/v1/payments/emd/bid/<id>/receipt.pdf returning 200 application/pdf — authenticated blob download confirmed live. (4) VendorSignaturesE page loads cleanly (data-testid='vendor-signatures-e' root, data-testid='vsig-heading' 'Nothing to sign yet' for this vendor's current envelopes) — statusPill 'signed' mapping and 20s polling + window-focus listener confirmed by code review. No pageerrors; one unrelated 401 on a background prefetch, one 404 on a background resource — not blocking.
